svg.title: Where flask upgrades land, by fill sphere
svg.desc: One panel per configuration and Elden Ring slot. Bars are fill spheres; segments are flask pickups classified by whether they advanced charges, granted a Sacred Tear, or fell past both caps and granted nothing.
svg.text: Where flask upgrades land, by fill sphere
Each bar is one fill sphere; the stack is what those pickups DID.
The flask holds 22 upgrades in total, so a seed with more copies than that has some that grant nothing.
flask pickups received in that sphere
